create_DatasetMapperAnn: create a DatasetMapperAnn instance to augment and transform image datasets for detectron2 training
call_DatasetMapperAnn: call a DatasetMapperAnn instance with a dataset dictionary to apply image augmentations and return transformed data
transform_annotations: transform annotations in a dataset dictionary using applied image augmentations and shape metadata
read_image_with_format: read an image file using detectron2 detection utils with a configurable image format
apply_augmentations: apply image augmentations via detectron2 transforms to an AugInput and return transformed image
